full_judgment: 2. The short facts, leading to issuance of the Rule, are that one Shah Kutubuddin Talukdar Ruyel, as the informant, lodged an FIR alleging, inter-alia, that on 26-9-2012 at about 6-30 am his father Md Jalal Uddin Talukdar, who is a former MP, was shot dead at his own residence and after taking him to hospital, the doctor declared him dead. In the FIR, the informant expressed his suspicion that his step-mother Aysea Begum and her son by her first husband, Masud Iqbal, killed his father with a motive to grab the property of the deceased. On the basis of the said Ejaher, Durgapur Police Station Case No. 14 dated 26-9-2012 under section 302 and 34 of the Penal Code was started. After lodging of the said case, Police Inspector Md Amirul Islam Dewan of the Crime Investigation Department, (CID), Mymensingh took up the investigation of the case and visited the place of occurrence, drew up the map of the place, seized the evidence & signs (Alamots) and recorded statements of the witnesses under section 161 of the CrPC and, after investigation, the Investigating Officer (IO) found it as a suicidal case and submitted the charge-sheet No. 144 dated 5-12-2013 under section 306 of the Penal Code against the informant for abetting the suicide, and recommended to the learned Magistrate for acquittal of the FIR-named suspected accused persons.
